biggest_catch: The friend must be a first-time Eagle member, and the $250 monthly direct deposit must be established within 60 days.
catches: Referrer and referred member each earn $50 deposited to their individual accounts after 60 days of account opening.
No limit to the number of referrals; also entered to win a $250 monthly referral prize drawing.
Referrer must be an existing Eagle CCU member in good standing and share a valid Eagle referral code (contact the CU to verify it).

Referred must be a first-time (NEW) Eagle member, present a valid Eagle referral code, open an Eagle CCU checking account, sign up for eStatements, and establish a monthly direct deposit of $250 or more within 60 days of account opening.
Bonus paid 60 days from account opening with verification of direct deposit and a valid checking account for the referral member.
Offer open through December 31, 2026; members responsible for all applicable taxes.
Eagle employees, volunteers, and their family members ineligible; not valid with any other offers; referral must meet Eagle eligibility requirements.
